source.dataset: WRI Aqueduct 4.0 — baseline annual water stress (bws)
source.citation: Kuzma, S., M.F.P. Bierkens, S. Lakshman, T. Luo, L. Saccoccia, E. H. Sutanudjaja, and R. Van Beek. 2023. "Aqueduct 4.0: Updated decision-relevant global water risk indicators." Technical Note. Washington, DC: World Resources Institute.

4.note: DERIVED, not published by WRI. Each basin takes the category covering the largest share of its area. A majority rather than a mean, because the categories are ordinal bands and two of them are not points on the scale.

6.note: WRI's published Level 6 values, deduplicated across the basin x subnational-admin rows. No aggregation, no interpolation.
